title: kube play: add platform selection for images and builds
body:
Add `--platform=OS/ARCH[/VARIANT]` flag to `podman kube play` to select the platform used by workload images and local Containerfile builds.

### Changes made
- Expose the flag through the CLI, remote bindings, and REST API.
- Register shell completion behavior for the new flag.
- Omit the platform query parameter when no platform is specified.
- Validate platform syntax before creating resources.
- Apply platform selection to regular and init-container image pulls.
- Check cached-image platform compatibility when deciding whether an automatic build is needed.
- Apply the requested platform to explicit and automatic builds.
- Handle the difference between kube play's string flag and Buildah's string-slice flag.
- Document the option and its limitations.
- Add integration tests for regular and init containers, pull policies, architecture aliases, cached-image mismatches, invalid and unavailable platforms, and explicit and automatic builds.

Image pull policies remain applicable. Infrastructure and service container images are unaffected. Selecting a platform does not configure emulation for foreign-architecture execution.

Fixes #29177
